data.description: New Launch in JVC – Studios to 3BR in Stylish High-Rise
data.display_address: Auresta tower, Jumeirah Village Circle, Dubai
data.long_description:
Auresta is a project by developer Tiger Properties located in Jumeirah Village Circle, comprising a ground level with retail spaces, seven parking levels, and 62 residential floors. The collection includes furnished studios, one- and two-bedroom apartments, and two-level three-bedroom residences.

The exterior emphasizes vertical lines and the lightness of form, aligning with the overall architectural style of the district. The modern façade features panoramic glazing and open balconies, creating a sense of light and spaciousness. Interiors are designed in a minimalist style with light tones, warm lighting, and natural materials. Decorative marble surfaces, wooden panels, textile accents, and designer furniture have been used throughout, with attention to detail fostering a cozy and serene atmosphere.

Amenities include a swimming pool, fitness center, yoga zones, kids’ pool and play area, sauna and steam rooms, sports courts, jogging and cycling tracks, barbecue areas, and lounge spaces. The complex is secured 24/7.

Nearby are Al Khail Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road. Travel times: 16 minutes to Downtown Dubai, 15 minutes to Burj Al Arab, 13 minutes to Dubai Marina, 18 minutes to Palm Jumeirah, 10 minutes to Dubai Hills Mall, and 25 minutes to Dubai International Airport.
